احتمال ظهور نتيجتكم (أو أقوى منها) لو ما: The probability of getting your result (or a stronger one) if there were no real difference at all. If it's below 0.05 we say the result is "statistically significant".
p = .03 → الفرق غالبًا حقيقي؛ p = .40 →: p = .03 → the difference is probably real; p = .40 → we don't have enough evidence of a difference.
درجة تأكدنا إن تقديرنا يمسك القيمة الحقي: How sure we are that our estimate captures the true value. The common 95% means if we repeated the study 100 times, 95 would hit it.
أقصى فرق مقبول بين نتيجة عينتكم والقيمة: The maximum acceptable difference between your sample's result and the true value in the population. Commonly ±5%. The smaller you make it, the larger the sample you need.
مدى يُرجَّح إن القيمة الحقيقية داخله. لو: A range likely to contain the true value. If the interval for the difference between two groups includes zero, you don't have strong evidence of a difference.
قد إيش الفرق «كبير» عمليًا، مو بس هل هو: How "big" the difference is in practice, not just whether it's significant. d≈0.2 small, 0.5 medium, 0.8 large. It matters because a huge sample makes any tiny difference "significant".
احتمال إن دراستكم تكشف الفرق لو كان موجو: The probability that your study detects the difference if it really exists. Commonly 80%. Low power = you miss real differences.
مقياس ثبات الاستبيان: هل فقراته متسقة مع: A measure of questionnaire reliability: are its items consistent with each other? From 0 to 1, and 0.7 or higher is usually considered acceptable.
لو قسنا نفس الشي مرتين بنفس الظروف هل نح: If we measured the same thing twice under the same conditions, would we get about the same result? A reliable tool doesn't fluctuate.

أسئلة إجابتها درجات موافقة (مثل: أوافق ب: Questions answered with levels of agreement (e.g. strongly agree … strongly disagree), usually 5 points. The sum of several items is treated as a number.

المجتمع كل من يهمّنا (مثل كل ممرضات المس: The population is everyone we care about (e.g. all the hospital's nurses), and the sample is the part we actually study. We want the sample to represent the population.
